_note: robofast PWI server (Alpaca Telescope + Focuser + Rotator) for MINERVA T1, through an SSH tunnel: docs/pwi.md, docs/remote.md.
PWI2 (legacy): stop the legacy control code (mainNew) before using this, so robofast is PWI2's only client.
PWI is reached on 127.0.0.1:7101 (PWI2); the tunnel's far end is the telescope's control PC, set up by the operator, not here.
allow_hardware is true, but nothing talks to the real PWI without --hardware on the command line as well (robofast/hwgate.py).
Limits (deg): min_alt = legacy telescope_N.ini HORIZON (21), max_alt = legacy scheduler.ini MAXALT (83); park = legacy control.telescope_park defaults (alt 25, az 0).
focus_min/focus_max (microns) = legacy telescope_N.ini MINFOCUS/MAXFOCUS (455/33000); ports = sites/minerva/instruments.json.
max_jog_deg: robofast-pwi-jog's largest relative move per axis (first hardware session: keep it small).
Only one of the PWI2 and PWI4 configs of a telescope runs at a time (same listen port); only one of PWI2 and PWI4 may own the mount.

allow_find_home false: robofast never homes this mount through the Alpaca server. T1's home sensor was replaced and PWI2's home-direction setting changed then (PWI2 settingsMount.xml vs settingsMount.20161219.badhome.xml), so a home may drive the wrong way: home with robofast-pwi-jog home --axis 0|1, one axis at a time, after the checklist in docs/pwi.md.

allow_unhomed_moves true: the engineering override for the first session (small jogs before homing, to check axis directions). It does nothing without --allow-unhomed on the command line; set it false once the mount homes reliably.

T1 live PWI2 settingsMount.xml (read 2026-11-02): homingMoveAzmCwWhenTrue=True, homingMoveAltUpWhenTrue=False (the 2016 badhome file had the opposite of both); azimuth home 4.90527 rad (281.05 deg), altitude home 0.81423 rad (46.65 deg); altitude limits hard 20-90, goto 20-86, track 20-87 deg; azimuth CW limit 510/450/480 and CCW -150/-90/-130 deg (hard/goto/track). PWI4's homing direction and limits must match these before any home (docs/pwi.md, checklist 7). T1 runs PWI4 4.1.6: per-axis homing needs 4.1.7+.
pointing_models: legacy telescope_1.ini [MODEL] per M3 port (files in PWI2's Mount folder on the telescope PC, confirmed 2026-11-08); the server reloads them after a PWI2 restart (docs/pwi.md).
